Core resource library

Manuals first. Everything else second.

The core shelf brings together MOHW and national HIV/STI/TB programme PDFs curated by HSTU, plus the Government of Jamaica Public Service Staff Orders. Documents open directly from the Resource Centre, while additional MOHW references are clearly separated as live official links.

Currentness checked against MOHW, HSTU and available national HIV/STI/TB programme reference files · September 2026

Training & learning

Build skills with verified learning.

Jamaica-first HIV/STI/TB learning plus carefully selected Caribbean and international courses. Cost and certificate status are shown separately so you know what to expect before opening a course.

Start local.C-TECH/MOHW Jamaica learning is prioritised. International courses supplement — not replace — current MOHW/HSTU manuals, policies and clinical guidance.

Research, Data & Evidence

One searchable gateway to trusted Jamaican, Caribbean and international research, surveillance, statistics and evidence relevant to HIV, STI, TB and public health.

Try a shorter topic, an organisation name or an acronym such as STATIN, PIOJ, PAHO, UNAIDS, WHO, CDC, UNICEF, RGD/NIRA or World Bank.

How this section is organised

Jamaican and HSTU/MOHW sources are prioritised first where they directly answer the search. International portals are then provided for comparison, specialist analysis and wider evidence. Direct links were checked during the September 2026 build. External sites can change after publication.

About this resource centre

A clearer doorway to trusted resources.

The HSTU Resource Centre keeps authoritative materials at the centre and provides one clear route to manuals, service directories, learning, research, programme references and HST Health Living media.

Source priority

Current MOHW and HSTU/national HIV-STI-TB programme material first, followed by clearly labelled supplementary references and learning resources.

Clinical governance
